Section 9I.7, unnumbered paragraph 1, Code 2026, 5 is amended to read as follows: 6 A nonresident alien, foreign business, or foreign 7 government, or an agent, trustee, or fiduciary thereof, which 8 owns an interest in agricultural land within this state on or 9 after January 1, 1980, shall register the agricultural land 10 with the secretary of state. The registration shall be made 11 within sixty days after January 1, 1980, or within sixty days 12 after acquiring the land or the interest in land, whichever is 13 later.
